pooler_config:
# Odyssey M2 variant (pool=session, workers=1)
# refs: rules.html, global.html, storage.html, features/pooling.html
workers 1
resolvers 1
backend_connect_timeout_ms 30000
log_format "%p %t %l [%i %s] (%c) %m\n"
log_to_stdout yes
listen {
  host "127.0.0.1"
  port 6435
}
storage "benchdb_store" {
  type "remote"
  host "127.0.0.1"
  port 5432
}
database "benchdb" {
  user "benchuser" {
    authentication "none"
    storage "benchdb_store"
    storage_user "benchuser"
    storage_password "benchpass"
    pool "session"
    pool_size 10
    pool_discard yes
    pool_smart_discard no
    pool_cancel yes
    pool_rollback yes
    pool_timeout 0
    pool_ttl 0
    server_lifetime 3600
    pool_reserve_prepared_statement no
  }
}
